name: She's Wooing the Sea Witch
source:
Petra Batumbakal likes many things: collecting rocks, kicking ass–whether at Dance of Death (Yaw-Yan/Sayaw ng Kamatayan) or Dungeons and Dragons–and Jubi Jaziri, the charming, cunning cutie who manages the General Goods store across the street. Normally, Petra would prefer to tackle her problems head-on; but just like any good protagonist, she finds the following obstacles standing in her way:

1. She does not know how to talk to cute girls like Jubi Jaziri.
2. Her older brother, Altan, might be crushing on Jubi.
3. Jubi and Piers, her other older brother, don’t get along.
4. Did Petra mention she doesn’t know how to talk to cute girls? 

When Piers extends an olive branch and offers to invite Jubi to a DnD session, can Petra the Merfolk Paladin smite her way to Jubi’s heart? Or is her love destined to turn into sea foam? 

[From [url=https://owltio.itch.io/shes-wooing-the-sea-witch]itch.io[/url]]
